title: Biltmore Hotel Miami: Bad Boys & Miami Vice Hotel Guide
description: The Biltmore Hotel in Coral Gables, opened in 1926, appears in Bad Boys and Miami Vice. History, the huge pool and booking tips.
h1: The Biltmore Hotel Coral Gables: the Spanish Revival landmark on screen
intro: With a tower modelled on Seville's Giralda, the Biltmore has dominated Coral Gables since 1926. Film and TV crews have long favoured it.
filming: The hotel appears in the Will Smith and Martin Lawrence action hit Bad Boys (1995) and was a recurring location for the TV series Miami Vice. Its Mediterranean architecture suits Miami's glamorous screen image.
facts: The Biltmore opened in January 1926, designed by Schultze and Weaver, after about ten months of construction.
At 315 feet, it was the tallest building in Florida at the time.
In the 1926 hurricane, the hotel sheltered survivors.
During World War II it served as a veterans' hospital, and later as a University of Miami medical school until 1968.
It was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1986 and restored as a hotel in 1987.
The pool was once reported to be the largest hotel pool in the United States.
visit: Coral Gables is a calm, tree-lined suburb a short drive from Miami's beaches. The golf course and pool are the highlights.
